notes: Frozen acquisition definition for real Markdown workload round 1 under #33, as corrected by CORRECTIVE-1 (human adversarial review on PR #34). Include/exclude globs are gitignore-style (patterns containing '/' are root-anchored; '**' spans path segments) and define the acquisition SAMPLING FRAME: a deliberate, pre-performance scope decision recorded per source in scope_rationale; the complete pinned-repository Markdown inventory (manifests/inventory/) makes everything outside the frame measurable. No redundancy-based or performance-based exclusion is applied at acquisition. storage_policy separates VENDORED from MATERIALIZE_ONLY sources: NEEDS_REVIEW license state must never permit public vendoring by default. Candidate snapshot bytes are NOT tracked in Git during the candidate stage; 'materialize' reconstructs and verifies them locally at the pinned commits. Candidate != final workload: no eligibility filtering, no representativeness selection, no byte modification. SPDX values are filled after reading the actual license files at the pinned commits; NEEDS_REVIEW means the identity was not confirmed from the license text.

license.note: LICENSE at the pinned commit is a custom Standard C++ Foundation license (copy/use/modify for personal or internal business use only); no SPDX identifier exists. Internal benchmark research use only; review before any wider redistribution.

sources.storage_policy_rationale: Custom Standard C++ Foundation license grants copy/use/modify for personal or internal business use only; license identity NEEDS_REVIEW. MATERIALIZE_ONLY is mandatory under the acquisition contract: a NEEDS_REVIEW license state must never permit public vendoring by default. Redistribution requires explicit upstream permission, which is not established; uncertainty is recorded, not resolved.
